messages:
jamie_support: Pinging team — ACME reported 403s from our hosted API around 09:12 UTC and says they don't see the corresponding audit log entries for those requests. They want to know if retention/purge or KMS rotation could explain missing logs. Escalating. ticket: #INC-2347

alex_sre: Thanks Jamie. Can you paste a repro (request id / timestamps) and which region + model?

jamie_support: Repro snippet and IDs:
```
POST /v1/generate
x-request-id: r-0a9f3c
time: 2024-06-15T09:12:27Z
customer: acme-corp
```
Region: eu-west-1, model: redwood-7b-instruct-v2

maria_security: Quick questions: 1) Are they comparing to the audit-export (S3) or Console logs? 2) Any scheduled KMS/HSM rotations in that window?

noah_backend: Console shows the API gateway accepted the request, forwarded to runtime. I see a 403 returned from the auth service at 09:12:27 for r-0a9f3c. But I'm not seeing an audit-entry in the console ingestion index for that request id — ingestion pipeline shows no errors for that time range.

alex_sre: Could be log-sampling or delayed ingestion. We had a short storage GC job on 2024-06-15 08:55 UTC that pruned ephemeral traces older than 30d. But this request is fresh. Not related.

maria_security: KMS rotation schedule: we rotated a customer-wrapping key for internal HSM cluster at 06:00 UTC that day but only affected keys marked for rotation. That rotation should never impact audit-log write — logs are signed with service key, not customer-wrapped. I'll double-check HSM rotation logs.

leah_legal: If this is an audit-log gap for customer-facing compliance data, we may need to notify ACME depending on scope. What's the time window and how many requests are missing?

jamie_support: ACME says ~25 request ids around 09:11–09:14 UTC missing from their exported audit report. They have a scheduled compliance review next week, asking for confirmation asap.

noah_backend: Running an export job check now. Querying raw write-ahead entries for the ingestion pipeline for 2024-06-15T09:10–09:20Z.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2347 — Missing audit log entries for customer acme-corp (severity: P2)

alex_sre: Preliminary: I can see the gateway accepted 24/25 requests; one request actually failed auth upstream and was rejected (403) before it hit our unified audit sink — that failure occurs before we attach full audit metadata. That explains the single missing entry. But for the other ~24 we should have entries.

maria_security: I checked HSM logs: no key compromise or error during 08:30–10:00 UTC. KMS rotation events are marked COMPLETE at 06:02 UTC. Not likely the cause.

noah_backend: Found ingestion backlog between 09:11:30–09:13:00 — our kafka consumer lag spiked due to a retention compaction job on the sink cluster, causing ~90s delay. Most entries were backfilled automatically; however a small batch failed schema validation due to a new optional field nullability change from last deploy. That batch (IDs starting r-0a9f3c-prefix) was dropped by the validator, hence missing in export.

alex_sre: That's the smoking gun. Validator change rolled in in the 03:00 deploy, but only triggered on these rare envelope shapes. Noah — can you list the dropped ids? Jamie — please correlate with ACME's list.

noah_backend: Dropped ids: r-0a9f3c, r-0a9f3d, r-0a9f40, ... (24 ids). I've exported them to a secure tmp S3 path and rehydrated the raw payloads.

maria_security: From a compliance perspective: These are audit events that failed schema validation and were not present in customer-facing exports. We need to assess retention exposure: are the raw payloads retained in rawWAL for 90 days? If yes, we can regenerate the audit export for ACME.

noah_backend: rawWAL retention is 30 days for ephemeral traces, 365d for audit-wal. These payloads are still present in audit-wal. I can reconstruct the missing audit entries and push a backfill job to the export S3. ETA ~2h for backfill and re-export.

leah_legal: Good. Plan for customer notification: we should tell ACME we identified missing entries caused by an internal schema validation issue, not by retention or key rotation. Offer remediation (backfilled export + confirmation). Do not use language implying data loss unless confirmed. I'll draft comms.

jamie_support: Draft notice to ACME? I'll hold until backfill completes. They asked for a timeline asap.

maria_security: Action items: 1) Noah run backfill (owner). 2) Alex coordinate deploy to revert or patch validator to accept optional field shapes (owner). 3) Leah draft customer notice with legal-approved wording (owner). 4) Jamie prep support ticket update and schedule a call if ACME requests (owner). 5) Maria to verify no keys/HSM influences (done).

noah_backend: Starting backfill now. Will post progress.

alex_sre: I'll open a short-lived canary to hit the validator in staging with the envelope shapes that triggered the drop. If ok, we'll push a patch to prod.

incident-bot: Backfill job INC-2347-backfill started by noah_backend at 2024-06-15T10:05:00Z

noah_backend: Backfill complete — exported corrected audit file to s3://redwood-audit-exports/acme/2024-06-15/reexport-20240615-1019.json (sha256: abc123...).

jamie_support: Sending the re-export to ACME now and offering a review call tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Draft verbal: "We identified an internal schema validation bug that caused a small number of audit events to be excluded from your export. We have reconstructed and re-exported the missing events. There was no KMS/HSM rotation impact and no retention purge involved."

leah_legal: Approved, tweak to: "no evidence of key rotation or retention policy causing loss; issue caused by schema validation in our export pipeline." Keep it factual.

maria_security: I'll attach HSM rotation logs and verification with the comms.

jamie_support: ACME replied: "Thanks — appreciate fast turnaround. Please include a signed statement we can file for our audit."

leah_legal: I'll produce a short signed attestation and coordinate with compliance.

alex_sre: Postmortem action: add CI tests for optional fields in audit envelope, and a validator alert for dropped batches.

jamie_support: Closing loop: ACME confirmed receipt and satisfied. I'll close the ticket after Leah sends attestation. :white_check_mark:

maria_security: Marking as resolved on security side. Will add notes to the incident timeline.

noah_backend: Marking backfill commit: d4f9a2. Patch PR opened to relax nullability check.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2347 resolved at 2024-06-15T11:13:09Z
